text_block_list.text:
It's the start of a new year, and Winning
Ticket, Biwa Hayahide, and
Narita Taishin
are visiting the shrine to make their first
prayer of the
year.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Look at all these people! New
Year's around here is like the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just look, it's super crowded, right? Same
as the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You make everything about the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Soon she'll be telling us how a washing
machine is like the Derby.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, all three of you did really well
last year.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, all three of you did really well
last year.

After Winning Ticket's first win, she
clinched another two for a
three-win
streak. Her rivals racked up some nice
results too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could've gotten Top Junior
though...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I was hoping I could too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way, you'd start bawling at the awards
ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could that be why I didn't get
picked?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're all almost at the Classics. You
should be proud.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You're all almost at the Classics. You
should be proud.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! First the Satsuki Sho, then the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho! But especially the derby!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an honor to win any of them... And I
want that honor more than
anything.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah, let's pray on it! I wish to win the
Yayoi Sho and move right
on to the
Classics!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and, and! I wanna race together with
Taishin and Hayahide! The
end!

The friendly rivals work hard together
toward the goal they've had
since they
first became classmates—to run in the
same race.

And that race is approaching faster than
they could've imagined.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Extra, extra!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Read all about it! Not only is Tickezo
racing in the Yayoi Sho, Taishin
will now
too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin too?! Waaah! Our time to race
together's finally cooome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh. You shouldn't be all too pleased.
Everyone's been talking
about how good
Taishin's looking.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All the more reason I need to step it
up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I wanna shorten the time I
need to go from zero to top
speed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nice. You're thinking more concretely.
That means you've been using
your head
when you train.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nice. You're thinking more concretely.
That means you've been using
your head
when you train.

The rivalry she has with Biwa Hayahide and
Narita Taishin is pushing
Ticket to enhance
her game.

Surely Ticket is pushing her rivals too.
We'll need to be in top shape
for this
race—not just for Ticket's sake, but for
Taishin's as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're here today at the Yayoi Sho! The
racers are now making their
way onto the
track!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey! We're all walking the runners' tunnel
together, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Quit yelling, the echo's crazy down here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you two never change.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
'Cause we're rivals! And rivals are friends
for life!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Quit it with that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It does feel special to be running with you,
but this doesn't change
anything for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm still gonna go all out to win this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way! Running with each
other isn't the goal—I've gotta
win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching you two out there. Make
me proud to be your rival.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right, here I go.

The Yayoi Sho—the first showdown
between friends—begins amid
resounding
fanfare.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which runner has what it takes to win the
Yayoi Sho?! They're in the
starting gate...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And they're off!
